name: Frog
intro: A frog is a small animal that can live in water and on land. It is great at jumping.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A frog is an amphibian.
It has long back legs for jumping.
Its skin is smooth and wet.
Some frogs are bright colors.
Many frogs are green or brown, so they can hide.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Frogs live all over the world.
Many live in or near ponds, lakes, and swamps.
Some live in rainforests, mountains, and even deserts.
Frogs like wet places.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Grown-up frogs eat bugs.
They also eat spiders, worms, and slugs.
A frog catches bugs with its long, sticky tongue.
Big frogs can eat mice.
Tadpoles eat plants.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A frog starts as an egg in the water.
The egg hatches into a tadpole.
A tadpole has a tail and breathes with gills.
It grows back legs, then front legs.
Its tail goes away, and it becomes a frog.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Frogs can breathe through their skin.
Each kind of frog has its own croak.
Some frog calls can be heard a mile away.
Some frog dads carry eggs on their backs.
A big clump of frog eggs is called frogspawn.
